prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high for optimistic forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions significantly underpredicted positive wins.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) are helpful overall, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+5.4% and +4.3%), despite an initial loss (-3.9%).
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) generally worked, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.3% and +6.3%), though one test showed a strong negative result (-4.3%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish layout, home hint, home new_flow, and sign_in redesign, as each has only one test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +5.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, hint: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +2.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 84.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.0%

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Stage Selection Redesign: Redesign the pick friend screen into a stage layout with distinct pet personality cards and clear visuals to streamline pet adoption selection. (why: Adoption has a 27.3% drop-off rate and past adoption redesigns demonstrated strong positive conversion gains (+5.4% and +4.3%).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Basics Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop interaction introduction screen right before final completion explaining how to hide, summon, and interact with the pet. (why: Support received multiple tickets about users being confused on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once desktop setup finished.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Certificate Customization Flow: Add an interactive official stamp component confirmation to the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet setup. (why: Adoption step drop-off is high (27.3%) with users taking a median 89s; interactive confirmation builds user attachment and completion commitment.)
3: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Animated Companion Preview Redesign: Rebuild the waiting screen layout into a split view with animated pet rendering status feedback while pet files are created. (why: Home wait time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or desktop display issues.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Visibility and Controls Hint: Add an informative tray visibility hint on the home intro welcome screen explaining how to bring the pet back if hidden. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing up on desktop and 3 emails asking how to control or bring back pets.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Two Column Choice Layout: Update the choose_path layout to a two-column grid format comparing path benefits directly side-by-side. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean completion time (514s), indicating user hesitation during path evaluation.)
6: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Story Scroll Welcome Redesign: Redesign the final home intro screen into a story scroll layout showcasing desktop pet habits and interactions. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 68.0% with very high mean completion time (5815s), needing a clearer final onboarding conclusion.)
